item.title: github: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now identifies users who are missing client telemetry or are using IDE/extension versions below the usage metrics minimums. It adds new per-user fields to expose these gaps.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Client telemetry user attribution and configurable capture
item.description:
Enterprise administrators can now attribute GitHub Copilot activity to a user in managed settings without collecting prompts, responses, or tool content. A new telemetry.capture.identity setting provides configurable client telemetry capture options.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Performance monitoring for Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server
item.description:
The public preview for performance monitoring of Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server adds more flexible ways to explore and visualize performance data. Users can query Microsoft-managed monitoring data directly through a telemetry endpoint.

  • Source: Azure Updates
